subject: Need underlying Fold7 65686/65695 registration evidence
body: Please provide the exact artifact/log/source for the independent physical locked-Fold7 shell experiment that showed 65686/65695 registration false under SSENSOR and type 36 coarse 0/90/180. Include device/build, execution identity/UID, registration call/result, and raw sample evidence if available. Agent01 can only elevate this to DEV-confirmed and recommend rejecting direct shell SensorManager if the underlying evidence is inspectable.
